dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail Message Board
dialogues.text: If you have anything to share, be it brooding or joyous, distressing or hilarious, write them down on our Message Board! Cat's Tail is all cat ears!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Listen up, that girl in red... and everyone else!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This is my official challenge! I shall be the Gliding Champion in the next Ludi Harpastum! I shall crush anyone that stands in my way in the contest fair and square!"

dialogues.speaker: Someone's reply
dialogues.text: "Who are you supposed to be again?"

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: We wish you the best of luck in taking home the Gliding Champion Cup and present it to your beloved. We shall look forward to your achievements and your next visit as usual.
